title: Remove the Defender
setup: The rook on f8 is the only piece keeping your heavy pieces off the back rank.
hint: Your rook and queen both look down the open file. What happens if the lone guard is made to trade itself?
explanation:
## The Idea

Black's king survives only because the rook on f8 covers the eighth rank. {{Re8}} offers your rook on the one square that guard has to watch.

If {{Rxe8}}, then {{Qxe8#}}: the guard is gone, and the pawns on f7, g7 and h7 seal every flight square. Black does better to decline with a pawn move that gives the king air, but that only trades rooks after {{Rxf8+}} {{Kxf8}}, and your queen is still on the board against nothing.
